name: dimension
title: world.dimension
lead: Another world of the server's group, by dimension id or its last part ("dungeon", "minecraft:the_nether"): that world's own `world` table.

usedIn.quote: `world.dimension(name)` is that world's own `world` table. Its
local dungeon = world.dimension("dungeon")    -- that world's `world` table; "minecraft:the_nether" works too
